gates.name: qa_check (twin SM_AR01_LOD0..3, pipeline)
gates.threshold: pass (budget 57000 = 50000 rifle + 7000 merged mag; UV1 required; texel = measured aggregate)

gates.name: density Metal class A (px/cm P5 / median / P95)
gates.threshold: median in [60, 125] (band 80-100 +-25 %), P5 >= 60, P5..P95 within +-25 % of the median

gates.name: density Metal class B (px/cm P5 / median / P95)
gates.threshold: median in [45, 100] (band 60-80 +-25 %), P5 >= 45, P5..P95 within +-25 % of the median

gates.name: density Metal class E (px/cm P5 / median / P95)
gates.threshold: median in [6, 18.75] (band 8-15 +-25 %), P5 >= 6, P5..P95 within +-25 % of the median

gates.name: density Furniture class C (px/cm P5 / median / P95)
gates.threshold: median in [22.5, 50] (band 30-40 +-25 %), P5 >= 22.5, P5..P95 within +-25 % of the median

gates.name: density Furniture class E (px/cm P5 / median / P95)
gates.threshold: median in [6, 18.75] (band 8-15 +-25 %), P5 >= 6, P5..P95 within +-25 % of the median

gates.name: density Furniture class B (px/cm P5 / median / P95)
gates.threshold: median in [45, 100] (band 60-80 +-25 %), P5 >= 45, P5..P95 within +-25 % of the median

gates.name: density Mag class C (px/cm P5 / median / P95)
gates.threshold: median in [22.5, 50] (band 30-40 +-25 %), P5 >= 22.5, P5..P95 within +-25 % of the median

gates.name: density Mag class E (px/cm P5 / median / P95)
gates.threshold: median in [6, 18.75] (band 8-15 +-25 %), P5 >= 6, P5..P95 within +-25 % of the median

gates.name: Metal set size (user decision: 2048 unless it cannot hold A 80-100 / B 60-80 at >= 70 % fill)
gates.value: 4096: texels needed at the class floors 5,521,323 vs 2048 capacity at 70 % 2,936,013
gates.threshold: smallest of 2048 / 4096 that holds the floors at 70 %

gates.name: fill Metal (4096)
gates.note: at 4096 a 0.70 fill puts the classes over their band tops (x {'A': 1.16, 'B': 1.16}): sharper than the user's A 80-100 / B 60-80 for the same memory (the set size is what costs)

gates.name: fill Furniture (2048)
fill Mag (1024)
gates.note: Mag 1024, not plan 5.3's 2048: at 2048 a >= 65 % fill puts class C at ~93 px/cm (2.3x the band top); 1024 holds C inside its band +-25 % at the fill

gates.name: UV0 overlaps LOD0 (per set = per twin tile; qa epsilon)
UV0 mirrored islands (flipped UV triangles, LOD0)
UV0 skeletal layout: every set in 0..1 (all LODs' parts)
maps: power of two, square (full mips in Unreal)
gates.note: BC sRGB; ORM linear (R AO, G roughness, B metallic); N DirectX (green flipped on write); Masks half size (R edge, G handling, B cavity, A refinishable)

gates.name: BC within the spec finishes; metallic exactly 0/1 (G7, B9)
gates.threshold: dielectric median within 12 levels of the finish sRGB, dielectric P1 >= 30 and P99 <= 243 sRGB, metal P1 >= 110 sRGB (bluing) / >= 186 (bare steel: chips, sliding faces), metallic values {0, 1}

gates.name: AO bake in Cycles
gates.threshold: Cycles AO of the assembled LOD0 at rest

gates.name: L5 colour vs the sheet (crop-matched; light scale fitted on the receiver, light specular factor on the stock R/B)
gates.threshold: luma +-0.05, saturation +-0.05, R/B +-0.1, hue +-4 deg (chromatic regions) on every region but the two calibration regions

gates.name: renders only from the baked maps
gates.value: review/tex/*.png via rifle_texrender.py (game materials on T_AR01_*; no procedural shading)

L5_wood.why: the sheet's four wood parts carry four R/B values (2.04-2.57); one stain hue x a luminance field (plan 5.2: the pack recolour reproduces the BC by construction) holds one R/B (ours 2.24-2.35 lit), so at most the parts near the mean can pass; luma and hue pass on every wood region
L5_wood.options: plan 5.2 fallback = fixed-colour wood (a hue per part, the recolour no longer reproduces the BC by construction): the user decides

notes.L5_rig: the light fit drives the specular factor to 0 (diffuse-only light), so blued / bare metal parts (selector, rear sight leaf) render black in review/tex/tex_side.png: a property of the L5 rig, not of the maps; physical lights (--physical) were tried and whiten every wood region (R/B 1.80-1.90) and leave the dust cover 0.08 dark
